nodes.name: Parse Context Registry and Build Fetch Requests

parameters.query: with input_json as (select $1::jsonb as p), input_data as (select p->>'worker_execution_id' as worker_execution_id, p->>'claim_token' as claim_token, p->>'locked_by' as locked_by, p->>'repository_full_name' as repository_full_name, (p->>'lock_ttl_minutes')::integer as lock_ttl_minutes from input_json), candidate as (select r.workflow_run_id from moex_n8n_workflow_runs r cross join input_data d where r.repository_full_name = d.repository_full_name and ((r.status = 'queued') or (r.status = 'retry_wait' and (r.next_retry_at is null or r.next_retry_at <= now())) or (r.status = 'processing' and r.lock_expires_at is not null and r.lock_expires_at <= now())) and coalesce(r.retry_count,0) < coalesce(r.max_retries,3) order by r.created_at asc for update skip locked limit 1), claimed as (update moex_n8n_workflow_runs r set status = 'processing', current_state = 'worker_claimed', current_phase = 'worker_poller', locked_by = d.locked_by, worker_execution_id = d.worker_execution_id, claim_token = d.claim_token, lock_expires_at = now() + make_interval(mins => d.lock_ttl_minutes), last_heartbeat_at = now(), heartbeat_count = coalesce(r.heartbeat_count,0) + 1, updated_at = now() from candidate c cross join input_data d where r.workflow_run_id = c.workflow_run_id returning r.workflow_run_id, r.idempotency_key, r.status, r.current_state, r.repository_full_name, r.current_phase, r.target_branch_name, r.retry_count, r.max_retries, r.next_retry_at, r.worker_execution_id, r.claim_token, r.lock_expires_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at), latest_intake_event as (select e.workflow_run_id, e.event_payload_json from moex_n8n_workflow_run_events e join claimed c on c.workflow_run_id = e.workflow_run_id where e.event_type = 'intake_ack' order by e.created_at desc limit 1), step_started as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (workflow_run_id, step_name, status, attempt, input_hash, started_at, created_at, updated_at) select c.workflow_run_id, 'worker_poller', 'started', coalesce(c.retry_count,0) + 1, c.idempotency_key, now(), now(), now() from claimed c on conflict (workflow_run_id, step_name) do update set status = excluded.status, attempt = excluded.attempt, input_hash = excluded.input_hash, started_at = excluded.started_at, updated_at = now() returning workflow_run_id), claim_event as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (workflow_run_id, previous_state, new_state, event_type, event_payload_json, created_at) select c.workflow_run_id, null, c.current_state, 'worker_claimed', jsonb_build_object('workflow_name','MOEX_ROUTE_B_WORKER_POLLER_V1_10_3','worker_execution_id',c.worker_execution_id,'claim_token',c.claim_token,'lock_expires_at',c.lock_expires_at,'effective_lock_ttl_minutes',(select lock_ttl_minutes from input_data),'retry_count',c.retry_count,'max_retries',c.max_retries,'attempt',coalesce(c.retry_count,0) + 1), now() from claimed c returning event_id), selected_job as (select true as has_job, c.workflow_run_id, c.idempotency_key, c.status, c.current_state, c.repository_full_name, c.current_phase, c.target_branch_name, c.retry_count, c.max_retries, coalesce(c.retry_count,0) + 1 as attempt, c.next_retry_at, c.worker_execution_id, c.claim_token, c.lock_expires_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, coalesce(l.event_payload_json,'{}'::jsonb) as intake_payload_json from claimed c left join latest_intake_event l on l.workflow_run_id = c.workflow_run_id) select * from selected_job union all select false as has_job, null::text as workflow_run_id, null::text as idempotency_key, null::text as status, null::text as current_state, null::text as repository_full_name, null::text as current_phase, null::text as target_branch_name, null::integer as retry_count, null::integer as max_retries, null::integer as attempt, null::timestamp as next_retry_at, null::text as worker_execution_id, null::text as claim_token, null::timestamp as lock_expires_at, null::timestamp as created_at, null::timestamp as updated_at, '{}'::jsonb as intake_payload_json where not exists (select 1 from claimed);

with input_json as (select $1::jsonb as p), input_data as (select p->>'workflow_run_id' as workflow_run_id, p->>'worker_execution_id' as worker_execution_id, p->>'claim_token' as claim_token, coalesce((p->>'attempt')::integer,1) as attempt, p->>'status' as status, p->>'current_state' as current_state, p->>'current_phase' as current_phase, p->>'validation_verdict' as validation_verdict, p->>'event_type' as event_type, p->>'step_status' as step_status, nullif(p->>'error_message','') as error_message, nullif(p->>'next_retry_at','')::timestamp as next_retry_at, nullif(p->>'fallback_route','') as fallback_route, nullif(p->>'durable_evidence_ref','') as durable_evidence_ref, coalesce((p->>'increment_retry')::boolean,false) as increment_retry, p->>'output_hash' as output_hash, (p->>'event_payload_json')::jsonb as event_payload_json from input_json), updated_run as (update moex_n8n_workflow_runs r set status = d.status, current_state = d.current_state, current_phase = d.current_phase, validation_verdict = d.validation_verdict, durable_evidence_ref = d.durable_evidence_ref, fallback_route = d.fallback_route, error_message = d.error_message, retry_count = case when d.increment_retry then coalesce(r.retry_count,0) + 1 else r.retry_count end, next_retry_at = d.next_retry_at, locked_by = null, worker_execution_id = null, claim_token = null, lock_expires_at = null, last_heartbeat_at = now(), updated_at = now(), last_completed_step = case when d.status = 'ready_for_review' then 'worker_poller' else r.last_completed_step end from input_data d where r.workflow_run_id = d.workflow_run_id and r.worker_execution_id = d.worker_execution_id and r.claim_token = d.claim_token returning r.workflow_run_id, r.status, r.current_state, r.current_phase, r.validation_verdict, r.retry_count, r.max_retries, r.next_retry_at, r.fallback_route, r.durable_evidence_ref, r.error_message), step_completed_update as (update moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s set status = d.step_status, output_hash = d.output_hash, completed_at = now(), error_message = d.error_message, updated_at = now() from updated_run u cross join input_data d where s.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id and s.step_name = 'worker_poller' and s.attempt = d.attempt returning s.workflow_run_id), step_completed_insert as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (workflow_run_id, step_name, status, attempt, output_hash, completed_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at) select u.workflow_run_id, 'worker_poller', d.step_status, d.attempt, d.output_hash, now(), d.error_message, now(), now() from updated_run u cross join input_data d where not exists (select 1 from step_completed_update) returning workflow_run_id), event_inserted as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (workflow_run_id, previous_state, new_state, event_type, event_payload_json, created_at) select u.workflow_run_id, 'worker_claimed', u.current_state, d.event_type, d.event_payload_json, now() from updated_run u cross join input_data d returning event_id) select u.*, (select event_id from event_inserted) as event_id from updated_run u;
